result.document_summary: A scraped portion of the San Diego Municipal Code, Chapter 4 (Health and Sanitation), covering storm water pollution enforcement (Art. 3, Div. 3) and smoking/vaping regulations (Art. 3, Div. 10), mis-served under a URL for the algorithmic rent-price-fixing division.
result.notes: No rules in the six in-scope categories appear in this part. The text covers storm water/MS4 protection (\u00a7\u00a7 43.0308-43.0312) and smoking and electronic cigarette regulation (\u00a7\u00a7 43.1001-43.1008). Although the source URL and metadata refer to San Diego's Division 11 'Prohibition of Anti-Competitive Automated Rent Price Fixing' (\u00a7 98.1103), none of that division's text is present in this part, so no algorithmic_rent_setting rule can be extracted from it.
